prompts:
A database newsletter's fact-check desk needs three facts confirmed before Friday's issue goes out, each against a primary source: the project's or the standards body's own website, not a wiki or a news story. This one needs the open web, and you are allowed to browse.

- `sqlite_3_40_0_release_date`: the release date of SQLite 3.40.0
- `postgresql_15_0_release_date`: the release date of PostgreSQL 15.0
- `unicode_15_0_characters_added`: how many characters Unicode 15.0 added

Record them in {WS}/result.json, one entry per key above, each an object with `value` (a date as YYYY-MM-DD, a count as a number) and `url` (the primary-source page that shows it).
answers: [result] `./result.json` written and validated as JSON: | key | value | primary source | |---|---|---| | sqlite_3_40_0_release_date | 2022-11-16 | https://sqlite.org/releaselog/3_40_0.html | | postgresql_15_0_release_date | 2022-10-13 | https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/15.0/ | | unicode_15_0_characters_added | 4489 | https://unicode.org/versions/Unicode15.0.0/ | [action] Fetched each page with curl (no browser, so nothing to close) and grepped the exact strings off the project's own site: - sqlite.org releaselog page ``/`<h2>`: "SQLite Release 3.40.0 On 2022-11-16" - postgresql.org release notes: `<p><strong>Release date: </strong>2022-10-13</p>` - unicode.org version page: "Unicode 15.0 adds 4,489 characters, for a total of 149,186 characters." and "4,489 characters have been added." [assumptions] Dates are the official release/publish date on the source page, in UTC as printed, formatted YYYY-MM-DD. "Characters added" = code points added in the 15.0.0 release (4,489), not the total. For PostgreSQL I used the docs release-notes page instead of a news item because the news slug I guessed (`postgresql-15-released-2534`) resolves to an unrelated SCaLE CFP article; the docs page is still the project's own primary source. My first draft had SQLite as 2022-06-17 from memory; the live page disproved it, so the file holds the fetched value. [next] Nothing pending; if the desk prefers the PostgreSQL announcement URL over the docs page, say so and I'll swap the citation (value unchanged).
